integrity: An unrestricted analytical proof is given; exact-rational facet checks and numerical stationary-point diagnostics are independent finite corroboration and cannot certify uniqueness by themselves.
scientific_limitations: Global minimization is over positive real weights, not positive integer weights. For dimensions above three the unique sharp constant is defined by finite nonlinear equations, without an elementary closed form. Historical priority is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Unique fixed-volume surface minimizers for weighted lecture-hall simplices
